metadata.description: dev | uat | prod.
Azure region.
Registry login server for THIS environment, e.g. crdijionenonprod.azurecr.io (dev/uat) or crdijioneprod.azurecr.io (prod).
Registry name, e.g. crdijionenonprod.
Resource group the registry lives in (rg-dijione-shared for dev/uat; rg-dijione-prod for prod).
service -> sha256 digest, e.g. { "platform-api": "sha256:abc..." }. When set it MUST cover every deployed service.
Fallback tag for a first bring-up only, when imageDigests is empty. A git SHA.
Deploy DijiBirthday (people-api, birthday-api, birthday-web, birthday-supplier-web + 2 jobs).
Deploy the commercial-api skeleton.

Deploy Diji On-site (onsite-api, onsite-web, migrate + sync jobs). Independently deployable/removable; requires people-api (deployed whenever DijiBirthday or Diji On-site is). See docs/onsite/architecture.md.
Deploy DijiAtWork (atwork-api, atwork-web, migrate and notification jobs). Independently deployable and removable. Separate authorization required before enabling.
onsite-api source mode. "mock" = MockOnsiteSource; "live" = SELECT-only Azure SQL onsite.* via the Container App system-assigned managed identity (no SQL password).
Azure SQL server host name for the Diji On-site source (ingestion plane). Only used when onsiteIntegrationsMode == live.
Azure SQL database name for the Diji On-site source. Only used when onsiteIntegrationsMode == live.
onsite-sync-job cron (UTC). Every minute in every environment for near-real-time attendance (docs/onsite/deployment.md "Refresh cadence"); the run is single-flight and incremental.
Container size — lean floor by default (Amendment 8).
Per-service replica floor. Empty = every service scales to zero (DEV/UAT). PROD sets platform-api + shell-web to 1.
Default replica ceiling and per-service overrides.
DEV only: create a Manual bootstrap-identity job that seeds the 5 staff dev-login personas (no business data). UAT/PROD create real users via the Admin Center.

Create a Manual bootstrap-talent-clients job that runs talent-api/scripts/seed.py — it pulls the canonical client directory from platform-api (GET /api/platform/internal/clients) and creates ONLY the talent-api clients extension rows (platform_client_id + name) in this environment, idempotent, no business data. Needed for the governed DTC tag -> Client resolution.

Internal identity mode for platform-api. "dev" = the passwordless persona switcher; "entra" = real Microsoft Entra ID OIDC (Authorization Code + PKCE). "entra" also requires entraTenantId, entraClientId, publicBaseUrl, and the entra-client-secret-<env> Key Vault secret.

Delegated application access administration (docs/platform/delegated-access.md): appointments and the /api/access endpoints. Off by default. Turning it off is always a safe rollback: existing suspensions stay enforced.
Entra directory (tenant) id. Only used when authMode == entra.
Comma-separated email domains of internal employees. Empty disables default module access.
Application (client) id of the per-environment DijiOne Entra app registration. Only used when authMode == entra.
Public HTTPS origin of shell-web for this environment, e.g. https://shell-web.<env-domain>. Backs the Entra redirect URI and the front-channel logout redirect.
Base URL of the TalentFlow client portal, used to build access links. Empty leaves the app default, which only works locally.

recruitment-api provider mode. "mock" = MockLeverClient; "live" = the GET-only LiveLeverClient, which also needs the lever-api-key-<env> Key Vault secret. Lever is READ-ONLY by construction (CLAUDE.md §60).

people-api provider mode. "mock" = MockBambooHrClient; "live" = the read-only live client, which also needs the bamboohr-api-key-<env> Key Vault secret and bamboohrSubdomain. Never writes to BambooHR.
BambooHR company subdomain (the <sub> in api.bamboohr.com/api/gateway.php/<sub>/v1). Only used when peopleIntegrationsMode == live.

birthday-api People-source mode. "mock" = MockEmployeeSource; "live" = PeopleApiEmployeeSource (consumes people-api over HTTP; birthday-api still holds NO BambooHR credential and no employee mirror). EMAIL_SENDING_MODE stays mock regardless (Phase 1 §1.9).

Birthday Supplier Portal auth. "dev" = the seeded SupplierUser persona picker; "entra" = real Microsoft Entra ID B2B guest sign-in (Auth Code + PKCE) via birthday-api, which also needs the birthday-supplier-entra-secret-<env> Key Vault secret. Independent of the internal DijiOne authMode.
Entra directory (tenant) id for supplier B2B guest sign-in. Only used when supplierAuthMode == entra. Same directory as the internal tenant.
Application (client) id of the per-environment dijione-birthday-supplier Entra app registration. Only used when supplierAuthMode == entra.
Public HTTPS origin of birthday-supplier-web, e.g. https://birthday-supplier-web.<env-domain>. Backs the supplier Entra redirect URI.
birthday-api MAIL_TRANSPORT. "" = not set (app default "null"); "null" = simulated, never sends; "graph" = Microsoft Graph sendMail via birthday-api's own system-assigned managed identity.
birthday-api MAIL_POLICY. "disabled" fails closed; "internal_allowlist" = DEV/UAT Email Safety allowlist only (never PROD); "production" = real supplier recipients.
birthday-api MAIL_SHARED_MAILBOX — the one mailbox the managed identity sends as (Exchange RBAC-scoped). Required when birthdayMailTransport == "graph".
atwork-api MAIL_TRANSPORT. "" = not set (app default "null"); "null" = simulated; "graph" = Microsoft Graph sendMail via atwork-api's system-assigned managed identity.
atwork-api MAIL_POLICY. "disabled" fails closed; "internal_allowlist" = DEV/UAT allowlist only (never PROD); "production" = real employee recipients.
atwork-api MAIL_SHARED_MAILBOX — mailbox the managed identity sends as. Required when atworkMailTransport == "graph".
Comma-separated email addresses or @domain entries allowed to receive atwork-api emails in DEV/UAT. Only honoured when atworkMailPolicy == "internal_allowlist".

Public base URL of the DijiAtWork application, e.g. https://shell-web.<env-domain>. Used as the base for email action links. Empty leaves the app default (localhost:3005 — links in emails will be broken).
platform-api MAIL_TRANSPORT. "" = not set (app default "null"); "null" = simulated; "graph" = Microsoft Graph sendMail via platform-api's own system-assigned managed identity.
platform-api MAIL_POLICY. "disabled" fails closed; "internal_allowlist" = Admin > Notifications test recipients only (DEV/UAT, never PROD); "production" = honoured by the app only when APP_ENV=prod.
platform-api MAIL_SHARED_MAILBOX — the mailbox platform-api sends as (Exchange RBAC-scoped). Required when platformMailTransport == "graph".

Per-service runtime RELEASE_DATE, keyed by service name. NEVER hand-edit in a .bicepparam: deploy/deploy.sh and deploy/promote.sh build it with deploy/release-dates.sh, which carries every live value forward and stamps only the apps named in RELEASE_APPS. A service absent from the map gets no RELEASE_DATE.

Custom-domain ingress bindings per service name: { 'shell-web': [{ name: 'dijione.example.com', certificateName: 'mc-...' }] }. The certificate is an existing managed certificate on this environment's Container Apps Environment (created when the DNS-validated domain was first bound). Declared here because ACA ingress is desired-state: a deployment that omits a live binding REMOVES it, which would break Entra sign-in redirects and the supplier portal hostname.

Override the Key Vault Secrets User role-assignment name that modules/identity.bicep creates — only needed when that (scope, role, principal) grant already exists in this environment under a different assignment id (created out-of-band before this template first ran here). Leave empty (the default) for a normal deployment.
Same override, for the bootstrap identity AcrPull role assignment (modules/acr-pull.bicep). Leave empty (the default) for a normal deployment.
